title: Conveniently located Nashville Couples Haven.
description:
Fully furnished and like new  Basement Apartment with private entrance. Only 3 miles to the Grand Ole Opry and 8 miles to downtown and Broadway with easy access to both.  Very well maintained with all amenities.    Located in Hip Donelson with great local restaurants; Nectar Urban Cantina, Homegrown Taproom, Party Fowl, Tennfold, McNamaras,  many others as well as the music valley drive music venues and restaurants in the Opry area .  Easy trip to downtown festivities & 10 minutes to  airport.

The space
Private entry with free driveway parking.  All areas designed for wheelchair access with easy entry including shower with sprayer and accessible sinks.  Full size kitchen with all amenities.  All linens and towels provided with assorted pillow types. 2- 55”4K firestick TVs.  Free WiFi.  Fully controllable central heating and air.

Guest access
We do have washer and dryer access if requested.

Other things to note
We do have cats and dogs that you may hear but they do not have access to apartment. Also can hear some movement in the home above since we live above the apartment.
